mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, outlet_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM product_inventory GROUP BY product_id, outlet_id ) inv ON inv.product_id = p.id AND inv.outlet_id = p.outlet_id

CASE WHEN left(btrim(p.name), 1) ~ '[0-9]' THEN 2 WHEN left(btrim(p.name), 1) ~ '[A-Za-z]' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE left(btrim(p.name), 1) WHEN '-' THEN 0 WHEN '$' THEN 1 ELSE ascii(coalesce(nullif(left(btrim(p.name), 1), ''), chr(32))) END ASC, lower(btrim(p.name)) ASC, p.name ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.shopfront_source_updated_at IS NULL OR p.case_cost IS NOT NULL OR p.cost_percentage <> 0 THEN p.cost ELSE NULL END AS cost_unit_safe, c.name AS category_name, b.name AS brand_name, (SELECT pp.price FROM product_price pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.quantity LIMIT 1) AS price, COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS stock_quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN left(btrim(p.name), 1) ~ '[0-9]' THEN 2 WHEN left(btrim(p.name), 1) ~ '[A-Za-z]' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END DESC, CASE left(btrim(p.name), 1) WHEN '-' THEN 0 WHEN '$' THEN 1 ELSE ascii(coalesce(nullif(left(btrim(p.name), 1), ''), chr(32))) END DESC, lower(btrim(p.name)) DESC, p.name DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY
LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS productCount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN p.case_quantity IS NOT NULL AND p.case_quantity > 0 THEN TRUNC(COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) / p.case_quantity) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS caseLevelTotal, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN p.case_quantity IS NOT NULL AND p.case_quantity > 0 THEN COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) - TRUNC(COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) / p.case_quantity) * p.case_quantity ELSE COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) END ), 0) AS itemLevelTotal, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN p.cost_percentage <> 0 THEN 0 WHEN p.case_cost IS NOT NULL AND p.case_quantity > 0 THEN p.case_cost * COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) / p.case_quantity WHEN p.shopfront_source_updated_at IS NULL THEN COALESCE(p.cost, 0) * COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0), 2) AS valueIncLastTotal FROM product p

SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.shopfront_source_updated_at IS NULL OR p.case_cost IS NOT NULL OR p.cost_percentage <> 0 THEN p.cost ELSE NULL END AS cost_unit_safe, c.name AS category_name, b.name AS brand_name, (SELECT pp.price FROM product_price pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.quantity LIMIT 1) AS price FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT pp.price FROM product_price pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.id AND pp.outlet_id = #{outletId} ORDER BY pp.quantity LIMIT 1) AS price FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN family f ON f.id = p.family_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.outlet_id = #{outletId} AND p.outlet_id IN (SELECT id FROM outlet WHERE vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT(#{stem}, '%') OR f.name LIKE CONCAT(#{stem}, '%') )
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 500
